name: OpenAI Whisper small.en offline model
versioning: The manual GitHub Action resolves the current official small.en URL from openai/whisper and treats the SHA-256 fingerprint embedded in that URL as the model version. The large upstream checkpoint is downloaded only when that fingerprint has not already been published here.

actions_artifact.purpose: Connector- and API-friendly transport for environments that can download GitHub Actions artifacts but cannot fetch binary release assets directly. The artifact is recreated on every successful manual workflow run without re-downloading the upstream PyTorch checkpoint when the model version is unchanged.

offline_note: Model files can be used without external network access after the selected runtime and all of its dependencies are installed locally. This repository distributes model data, not whisper-cli, Python, PyTorch, or FFmpeg.
python_example:
import whisper
model = whisper.load_model("small.en", download_root="./whisper-small-en")
result = model.transcribe("audio.mp3", language="en")
print(result["text"])
